channel.title: Ocean News & Technology Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: Research Finds Crustacean Fishing in the North Sea Disturbs Seabed Carbon
item.description: Crustacean fishing (including Norway Lobster, which is used to make scampi) in the North Sea could be driving a "largely invisible" climate cost by disturbing carbon that has been buried in the seabed for thousands of years, scientists have found.

item.title: Teledyne Marine Launches SeaBat D100
item.description: Teledyne Marine has announced the launch of the SeaBat D100, the first model in its new D Series, a deep-water multibeam product line, ahead of Oceanology International 2026.

item.title: Interocean Partners with JERA Nex bp to Drive Global Offshore Wind Operations
item.description: Interocean Marine Services (Interocean), a leading provider of offshore support services, has signed a Master Services Agreement with JERA Nex bp covering specialist marine consultancy and assurance services in support of its North Sea and global offshore wind operations.

item.title: HII and Nominal Team to Compress the Autonomous Unmanned Production Curve
item.description: HII, the world’s leading manufacturer of autonomous surface and underwater unmanned vehicles, and advanced engineering and test firm Nominal, announced a partnership to modernize the collection, validation, and analysis of data, including digital-twin test and mission data, for HII’s REMUS family of autonomous unmanned underwater vehicles (UUVs) and ROMULUS unmanned surface vehicles (USVs).

item.title: GeoAcoustics Reveals New Low-Voltage Boomer at Oi 2026
item.description: Sonar manufacturer GeoAcoustics Ltd has expanded its sub-bottom profiler portfolio with the launch of GeoPulse LF 101, a new low-voltage boomer system. GeoPulse LF 101 makes its industry debut this week at Oceanology International 2026 at ExCeL London (stand P400), introducing one of the lowest-voltage boomer sub-bottom profilers currently available to the marine geophysical sector.

item.title: Babcock Launches Joint Skills Mou with Fife and Forth Valley Colleges to Boost Scotland’s Defense Workforce
item.description: Babcock International Group (Babcock), the defense company, Fife College, and Forth Valley College are to accelerate the development of Scotland’s defense and advanced manufacturing workforce through a new joint skills pact outlined in a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed by the three organizations.

item.title: Fugro Supports Ireland’s Planned First Commercial Offshore Wind Farm
item.description: Fugro has been awarded a contract by Oriel Windfarm Ltd to deliver a detailed geotechnical site investigation that will inform the design and installation of foundations for 25 offshore wind turbines, supporting safe and efficient construction at the Oriel offshore wind farm. Located off the coast of County Louth, the 375 MW project is planned to be among Ireland’s first commercial-scale offshore wind farms and is being jointly developed by JERA Nex bp and the Irish semi-state utility ESB.

item.title: -4H-Jena Engineering Introduces Commercially Purified mCP to Improve Seawater pH Data Comparability
item.description: 4H-Jena engineering GmbH has become the only commercial provider with the ability to offer large-scale purification of meta-Cresol Purple (mCP) for spectrophotometric seawater pH measurement. The capability is now available in direct support of its CONTROS HydroFIA™ pH analyzer, addressing a long-standing challenge in marine carbon system monitoring.

item.title: Ashtead Technology Underscores Sonardyne’s Fusion 2 LBL as the Gold Standard
item.description: Sonardyne’s leadership in underwater navigation and positioning has been further reinforced by a major new order for its Fusion 2 platform and 6+ technology from the global subsea solutions provider Ashtead Technology.
